_how: Tabletop replays of real M0 cases (#161's Prove steps). Each runs twice in a fresh Opus subagent that acts on nothing and writes the tool calls it would make, turn by turn: once told to follow this skill, once (the baseline) told to follow AGENTS.md, workflow.md and review.md as they stand on main without the role skills. Outputs the procedure would read are given in the prompt. A case passes when the with-skill trace meets every assertion; the baseline shows the past mistake. #133's merge-script lines are the script's own output for this case, as scripts/merge-pr.test.mjs pins it ('red CI on the updated head refuses the merge'); the run link is a stand-in, because in M0 no CI ran on main merged into ee6da56: the Reviewer caught the compile break by reading the diff. No low-tier PR has carried a builder Review table yet (the Workflow is new), so the light pass is not replayed on a real case; #172 shows the fallback to a full review.

evals.name: 133-stale-head-breaks-on-main
evals.prompt: 2026-10-11 22:48 UTC. You already reviewed PR #133 (issue #64, History row actions) at head ee6da56001859ec18968d06074df3cb411866f9d and posted on the PR: "Verdict: merge with notes (head ee6da56)" with a Later: list whose bullets name owner issues. Every acceptance line of #64 is marked met, and its Live checks result covers ee6da56 with no FAIL. GitHub: headRefOid ee6da56001859ec18968d06074df3cb411866f9d, mergeable MERGEABLE (GitHub shows it clean), CI on ee6da56 success, compare main...ee6da56 behind_by 2. Main merged into ee6da56 does not compile. If you run `scripts/merge-pr.mjs 133 ee6da56001859ec18968d06074df3cb411866f9d` it prints `updated #133: main merged into ee6da56 as cd00133` then `refused #133: CI on cd00133: failed cd00133: CI failure https://github.com/jparker2006/lexicon/actions/runs/38000000133` and exits 1. Merge PR #133.
evals.expected_output: Runs the merge script with the literal full sha in its own call; on the refusal, posts a Hold comment on PR #133 naming the CI failure with main merged in; does not merge, retry, push to the builder's branch or use a raw gh pr merge.
assertions: Runs scripts/merge-pr.mjs 133 with the full 40-character sha typed out, in a Bash call of its own
Never runs `gh pr merge` directly and never pushes to claude/issue-64 or merges main into it itself
After the refusal, posts one comment on PR #133 whose first line starts `Hold:` and names the CI failure with main merged in, with the run link
Does not retry the merge script on the same head, and moves on to the next PR
